ai_summary_zh: 本案場為河岸施工便道，路面主要為壓實土石結構。現場植被茂密，平均胸徑(DBH)達43.7公分，河道水域空洞高程位於TWVD2001 +42.11公尺處，並設有18處擋土牆結構以維持邊坡穩定。
ai_summary_en: The site features a compacted dirt haul road corridor with dense riparian vegetation, showing a mean DBH of 43.7 cm. The un-modelled river water void shoreline is situated at an elevation of TWVD2001 +42.11m, supported by 18 retaining wall structures to ensure slope stability.
